name: disqus
description: Disqus comment system. Requires a Disqus shortname. Rendered via comments.html when .Params.comments = true on a page.

params.description: Your Disqus site shortname (from disqus.com dashboard)
params.effect: Enables Disqus comments. Pages also need front-matter comments: true

config.also_requires: Page front-matter: comments: true (via comments.html routing)

js.note: Dynamically loaded from Disqus CDN. No local file.

locked.reason: Disqus embed.js mounts the comment widget into #disqus_thread

partials.note: Can modify but must keep
Override to switch comment system or add multiple systems
